traits.life_span.note: Flora of China vol. 5, Basella (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): twining herbs, annual or biennial; Wikipedia calls B. alba a perennial vine.

traits.inflorescence.note: Flora of China vol. 5, Basella (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): spikes axillary, the rachis long and thick.

traits.flowering_position.note: Flora of China vol. 5, Basella (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): spikes axillary.

traits.pedicel_length_m.note: Flora of China vol. 5, Basella (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): flowers sessile.

traits.perianth_fused.note: Flora of China vol. 5, Basella (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): urceolate perianth, the segments short; FNA family: petals basally connate.

traits.corolla_shape.note: Flora of China vol. 5, Basella (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): urceolate perianth that opens very little at anthesis (the vocabulary's corolla_shape is used for the perianth).

traits.stamen_exsertion.note: Flora of China vol. 5, Basella (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): stamens included; filaments very short, near the top of the perianth tube.

traits.fruit_shape.note: Flora of China vol. 5, Basella (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): utricle globose, fleshy.

traits.calyx_in_fruit.note: Flora of China vol. 5, Basella (eFloras, read 2026-10-19): bracteoles and perianth grow fleshy and enclose the fruit after flowering, not winged; the whole looks like a berry.
